overview_description.description: Zoomer is a venture backed, fast growing, technology startup that is going to change the restaurant delivery space forever. This is an opportunity to get in on the ground floor of an organization that is moving at lightning speed and began generating meaningful revenue on day one. As Zoomer's General Counsel you’ll help shape Zoomer Operations for the long term (translation: get ready to make a huge impact). They are a small team with a heavy punch and they take every new addition very seriously.
